Create a new pull request

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-226`

## Response

**201** — PullRequest

- **403** — User blocked or must be collaborator
- **404** — Repo or branch not found
- **409** — PR already exists for same head/base
- **422** — Head equals base, invalid assignee, or refs not branches
- **423** — Repository is archived

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Head branch must differ from base branch when creating PR | validation | form.Head == form.Base |
| Base and head refs must be branches (not tags or commits) for PR creation | validation | !compareResult.BaseRef.IsBranch() || !compareResult.HeadRef.IsBranch() |
| Cannot create duplicate PR with same head/base targets | business_logic | Unmerged PR exists with same head repo, base repo, head branch, base branch |
| PR creator must be collaborator/member/org-member or have write on head repo | authorization | !canCreate && !perm.CanWrite(unit.TypeCode) |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Unmerged PR with same targets exists | 409 | error | False |
| Poster blocked by repo owner | 403 | forbidden | False |
| User not collaborator/member | 403 | forbidden | False |

### Error Paths

- **head == base** → repo.CreatePullRequest → 422
- **PR already exists** → repo.CreatePullRequest → 409
- **User blocked** → pull_service.NewPullRequest → 403

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** medium

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ❌ missing | medium | PR creation involves multiple steps (create issue, create PR, add assignees, push ref, sync divergence) in a transaction, but git push is outside the DB transaction |

**Non-atomic operations:**
- ⚠️ Git push to base repo ref happens after DB transaction commits; failure leaves PR in DB without git ref

**Cascading failure risk:** Git repo unavailability would cause PR creation to fail with 500

**Graceful degradation:** Cleanup removes git ref on failure (best-effort)
